items.item: 1d. CLASSICAL-TEXTS M1: C-17 glosses the condition as a premise (「其延续都有意义……理论以之为前提」) beside C as 「比较读法」
items.how: The fault was already gone here: the condition is 「它在本论之中表示一个范围，此定理以之为假设」 and C 「对次序的一项要求之名」, as 06:18 and 06:426 say them. The ED6 proposal (「一种读法，本论不断言」) is the withdrawn frame and was not taken. I gave the gloss its full form, as GLOSSARY.zh:82 and BUDDHIST-THOUGHT:25 say it: 「对任何东西，其延续都有意义」 -> 「从每一个立场看，对任何东西，其延续到未来都有意义」.

items.item: 1e. CLASSICAL-TEXTS M2: C-17's weakness and question 44 ask about 「比较之承诺」, a reading 06 withdrew; add 06's 「本论读其结构，不以之为据」
items.how: 06:626 says 「“天地之大德曰生”可与重生之评价相参，不因此等同于 C，也不是定理；本论读其结构，不以之为据」; 06 dropped 「读作一项比较承诺的表述，相当于 C」 in a7254387a (9 November 2026). C-17 读法: after 「也不是定理」 added 「；本论读其结构，不以之为据」 (the dossier keeps its own 「不因此等同于以扩大排序」). 已知之弱: 「“比较之承诺”是现代伦理学的框架，不是易传自己的话；」 -> 「旧读以之为一项比较之承诺（相当于 C），2026 年 11 月 9 日已不取；“重生之评价”仍是今人之辞，不是易传自己的话；」. Q44: 「视之为一项比较之承诺，是否合宜？」 -> 「本论把它与重生之评价相参，而不等同于以扩大排序，只读其结构，不以之为据：这样读是否合宜？」.

items.item: 1f. CLASSICAL-TEXTS M3: C-34 and C-35 leave out that the 中华本 is in history/ and not revised since; C-34's 「名表须随之改写」 where 06 says 「以根为基重写……未做」
items.how: 06:506 (§7.3): 「此本卷首署 2026 年 10 月 21 日，22 日仍有修订；10 月 23 日移入 history/，其律今由八章陈述……此后各章的修订未入其中」; 06:660: 「它陈述在 World 模型上，已移入 history/；以根为基重写一本古名之论，未做」; 06:126 anchors the 名表 「于 World 模型与诸世界之声明」. git log shows one commit on history/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING-ZHONGHUA.md, the move of 23 October (0d7a397a5). C-34: 「名表锚于 World 模型，理论改以根之文法为基后，名表须随之改写。」 -> 「名表锚于 World 模型与诸世界之声明；中华本于 2026 年 10 月 23 日移入 history/，此后各章的修订未入其中；以根为基重写一本古名之论，未做。」 C-35 读法: 「中华本每条先立……」 -> 「中华本（卷首署 2026 年 10 月 21 日；10 月 23 日移入 history/，此后未再修订，其律今由八章陈述）每条先立……」.

items.how: PHILOSOPHY P-16 (354), the quotation of 07:392 re-taken: '... as C asks on that listing: what holding one's own continuation does where nothing lies outside it.' -> '... what self-concern does where nothing lies outside it.' (check_dossiers' one problem, now 0). PHILOSOPHY P-21 (503): ', where C alone leaves them unranked (`Ranking.basic_first_ranks`).' -> ', where C asks nothing of them (`Ranking.basic_first_ranks`).' (checked against Ranking.lean:431-460, stepwise_unranked and relational_unranked: neither course extends the other once the focal formation has an included event, so C, which asks a ranking only of extensions, asks nothing; basic_first_ranks:512 takes Lexical.BasicPriority under both readings); and the optional one: 'The continuation condition and an order ranking by widening do not yet give choices.' -> 'The continuation condition and a self-concerned order or one meeting C do not yet give choices.' (07:909's form). The relation named, 07's form (571, 982): PLAN.md:20 and COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION.md:30 'it holds where relations close, read across all steps;' -> 'it holds where relations of being affected close, read across all steps;'; also PHILOSOPHY's front question 2 (37) 'where relations close, read across all steps' -> 'where relations of being affected close, read across all steps', and the cover's philosophy row (review/README.md:20) 'where relations close along being affected, read across all steps' -> 'where relations of being affected close, read across all steps' (README.zh.md's 「在关系沿“受影响”闭合之处」 already names it). ALIGNMENT:516's 'what holding one's own continuation does between listed courses' is a dated history line of what 07 said on 9 November and stays. No other quote in my files of a 07 sentence ch07x changed (searched 392, 395, 571, 686, 775, 784, 891, 909, 982 phrases).

items.item: 3. ALIGNMENT.md:7: AGENTS.md's aim first, then AJ's conditions as the plan's
items.how: '... so the unit is that joint selection, aligned, in [AJ's plan](...#1-the-goal), where control of the rule is not captured, a lock is left in time, and courses are compared by widening. The plan reads the first two failing together, ..., as the [meta-attractor](#terms). From these laws we want to design an alignment that keeps the joint selection out of that loop and out of instrumental convergence (whose resource-keeping half A-03 states, a relation no result here joins to the loop); results 3 to 6 ...' -> '... so the unit is that joint selection. From these laws we want to design an alignment that keeps humans and AI, selecting together, out of instrumental convergence and the [meta-attractor](#terms): a joint selection that reads beyond its own share and does not come to select for control over its own selection. [AJ's plan](...#1-the-goal) says when that joint selection is aligned, by three conditions: control of the rule is not captured, a lock is left in time, and courses are compared by widening; it reads the first two failing together, capture of the rule selected and the rule it shapes locked, as the meta-attractor. Instrumental convergence's resource-keeping half is stated in A-03, a relation no result here joins to that loop; results 3 to 6 ...'. The aim's words are AGENTS.md:7's, verbatim, with a link on 'meta-attractor'. The three conditions are PLAN §1's. No test, front or crosswalk entry quotes the old sentence. A clause in the ninth-pass history bullet (ALIGNMENT:716) records it.
